summary: Emit fractal client-API, error and visualization versions from the server

replay.detail: No replay, backfill or rewriting stored or signed history.

schema.detail: No schema or generated client changes. Existing schema enums accept both version families.

rules.detail: No admission, digest, signature or idempotency-domain changes. Issued lpv0 preview tokens retain the frozen st3.client.v0 hash input; launch page cache/cursor digests retain st3.visualization.v0 bytes independently of the emitted visualization version.

compatibility.detail: Server responses emit fractal.client.v0, fractal.client.error.v0 and fractal.visualization.v0. Anonymous capability-advertisement tests track the exported server API version, independently of generated client request defaults. Server WebSocket constants use fractal.client.*; negotiation still selects the spelling offered by each client, including st3.client.*. Legacy request versions remain readable permanently. Requires the deployed Stage 0 accepting readers through 5d27423414f0570449e6237f97f087386de06b5c.

downtime.detail: Normal restart; writer rollout needs deploy approval.

recovery.detail: An accepting-reader release can be restored without rewriting data.
